YEARLY FIXED COST (from marina-costs.csv, as recorded by Analyst P44):
- Licence: AED 17,500
- Rent: AED 150,000
- Total: AED 167,500 per year

So: the arithmetic (17,500 + 150,000 = 167,500) is correct and verifiable from the CSV, but every underlying number is an unverified assumption, not a confirmed quote or official fee schedule.

FINAL RECOMMENDATION: Do not commit capital on the basis of W-1876d270 / W-a0f41e15 as they stand. Treat AED 167,500 as a planning placeholder only. Before proceeding, the owner should: (1) obtain at least 2–3 written rent quotes for a ~500 sq ft unit on or near Marina Walk to confirm the AED 150,000 midpoint; (2) confirm the current DED trade-licence fee for an F&B establishment with a DED agent or the DED portal; (3) add the usual missing fixed-cost lines (municipality/food-safety fees, initial fit-out amortised, utilities deposit, insurance, initial marketing) which are not in the CSV; and (4) re-run the breakeven analysis once real quotes replace the assumptions.
